description: This Java class 'AppleOAuth2ClientMapper' handles OAuth2 user mapping for Apple authentication, including extracting user attributes from request parameters and creating or retrieving security user objects.

classes.name: AppleOAuth2ClientMapper
classes.description: A Spring service class that maps OAuth2 user info from Apple to internal security user representations, extending AbstractOAuth2ClientMapper and implementing OAuth2ClientMapper.

methods.name: getOrCreateUserByClientPrincipal
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a SecurityUser based on OAuth2 authentication token and request data.

methods.name: updateAttributesFromRequestParams
methods.description: Updates user attributes with data parsed from request parameters, especially handling nested JSON user info.

methods.name: toMultiMap
methods.description: Converts a map of string arrays to a MultiValueMap for easier parameter handling.
